judge.rationale: The candidate ignored almost all explicit specifications in the ticket, inventing its own frame and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionListMessage` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationListMessage`). It completely omitted the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history` configuration flag, the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, and `StoreCannotList`. Furthermore, it directly violated explicit requirements and acceptance criteria: when `listFor` is absent on the store, it returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) instead of an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame, and in validation it accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of bounding `limit` to 1–200. It also left a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository and skipped updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
